# T020 实施方案

2026-11-27，T019 的四块试转画板通过验收。用户收到「下一步是 T020 的 165 项全量转换」后回复「开始吧」，确认本轮执行全量转换。使用试转的同一 Figma Design 文件。 [原任务](../tasks.md#phase-8-user-story-6---一次启动将原型页面和状态转换为可编辑画板priority-p2) · [试转结果](../analysis/figma-conversion.md#t019-代表性试转)

按已经实测的 15 个视图和导航组合生成 165 个独立采集项，桌面 84 项，手机 81 项。沿用 1440 × 900 和 390 × 844 视口。先以路径、期望可见内容和真实控件操作核对每项，再以一次启动的 Playwright 批次驱动 Figma 官方采集脚本。每次提交消费各自的采集编号，按服务返回的回执和后续编号推进。将回执逐项保存，以实际落图状态恢复失败项。 [实际原型清单](../analysis/figma-conversion.md#页面与视口) · [转换方式实测](../analysis/figma-conversion.md#t018-转换方式实测)

在同一 Design 文件中使用「T020 全量转换」页组织具名原生画板。沿用试转验证过的视口裁切、桌面顶栏内边距、首页原纹理平铺、Noto Serif SC 标题、已确认的 Noto Sans SC 中文无衬线替代和 Three.js 静帧处理。逐项核查画板唯一映射、正文与导航状态、原生文字与布局、字体布局和实际图像。将链接、差异和通过、失败或缺前置记录写入分析，达到原任务的 100% 条件后更新 T020。 [Design 文件](https://www.figma.com/design/xd4v3YLbHr6MFrshieoSPs/Untitled?node-id=0-1) · [验收契约](../contracts/site-navigation.md#页面转换契约figma)

   desk.push({folders,dropdown,label});
 }
 const phone=[{menu:"closed",drawer:false,folders:null,label:"默认"},{menu:"expanded",drawer:false,folders:null,label:"主菜单展开、技能集合展开"},{menu:"collapsed",drawer:false,folders:null,label:"主菜单展开、技能集合折叠"}];

   const articleId="chapter-"+item.chapter.toLowerCase();
   if(item.chapter==="MCP"){
     const button=page.locator('section[data-index="0"] nav[aria-label="章节"] button').nth(1);
     if(item.viewport==="mobile")await button.tap();
     else await button.click();
   }
   await page.waitForFunction(id=>{
     const title=document.getElementById(id);
     const section=title?.closest("section");
     if(!section?.parentElement||section.dataset.revealed!=="true")return false;
     if(Math.abs(section.getBoundingClientRect().top-section.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect().top)>8)return false;
     const status=section.querySelector("figcaption")?.textContent??"";
     return status.includes("实时渲染")||status.includes("静态预览");
   },articleId,{timeout:38000,polling:150});
 }else{
   const title=await page.locator("main h1").textContent();
   assert.equal(title.trim(),item.heading);
 }
 const fonts=await page.evaluate(()=>Promise.race([document.fonts.ready.then(()=>true),new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(()=>resolve(false),12000))]));
 await page.addScriptTag({path:library});
 assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>typeof window.figma?.captureOnceForDesign),"function");
 return fonts;
}
async function sourceEvidence(page,item,fonts){
 assert.equal(new URL(page.url()).pathname,item.path);
 const canvas=item.chapter?await page.locator('section[aria-labelledby="chapter-'+item.chapter.toLowerCase()+'"] figcaption').innerText():null;
 const main=item.chapter?page.locator('section[aria-labelledby="chapter-'+item.chapter.toLowerCase()+'"]'):page.locator("main");
 const content=(await main.textContent()).replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
 assert.ok(content.includes(item.heading));
 const screenshot=await page.screenshot({path:workspace+"/"+String(item.ordinal).padStart(3,"0")+"-source.png",scale:"css",timeout:28000});
 return {path:new URL(page.url()).pathname,heading:item.heading,contentHash:hash(content),fontReady:fonts,drawer:item.drawer,menu:item.menu,dropdown:item.dropdown,folders:item.folders,modelStatus:canvas?.replace(/\n/g," / "),referenceSha256:hash(screenshot)};
}
function payloadReceipt(response,item){
 const raw=JSON.parse(response.request().postData());
 const data=JSON.parse(raw.payload);
 assert.equal(data.viewportRect.width,item.width);
 assert.equal(data.viewportRect.height,item.height);
 const strings=[];
 function walk(node){
   if(typeof node?.text==="string")strings.push(node.text.trim());
   for(const child of node?.childNodes??[])walk(child);
 }
 walk(data.root);
 assert.ok(strings.some(value=>value===item.heading||value.includes(item.heading)));
 return {payloadBytes:Buffer.byteLength(raw.payload),payloadSha256:hash(raw.payload),viewport:data.viewportRect,textNodes:strings.length,assetCount:Object.keys(data.assets??{}).length};
}
function scopedEndpoint(endpoint,nextId){
 if(!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(nextId))throw new Error("Figma did not issue a valid later capture ID");
 const result=endpoint.replace(/\/capture\/[^/]+\/submit/,"/capture/"+nextId+"/submit");
 const url=new URL(result);
 assert.equal(url.origin,"https://mcp.figma.com");
 assert.ok(url.pathname.includes(nextId));
 return result;
}
const receipts=[];
let context=null;
let page=null;
let currentViewport=null;
let currentView=-1;
let fonts=false;
async function resetPage(item){
 if(context)await context.close();
 context=await browser.newContext({viewport:{width:item.width,height:item.height},isMobile:item.viewport==="mobile",hasTouch:item.viewport==="mobile",deviceScaleFactor:1});
 page=await context.newPage();
 page.setDefaultTimeout(19000);
 currentView=-1;
 currentViewport=item.viewport;
}
try{
 for(const item of list){
  if(currentViewport!==item.viewport)await resetPage(item);
  const earlyErrors=[];
  let proof=null;
  for(let trial=0;trial<2&&!proof;trial++){
   try{
    if(currentView!==item.viewIndex){
      fonts=await visit(page,item);
      currentView=item.viewIndex;
    }
    if(item.viewport==="desktop")await setDesktop(page,item);
    else await setMobile(page,item);
    proof=await sourceEvidence(page,item,fonts);
   }catch(error){
    earlyErrors.push(safe(error));
    await resetPage(item);
   }
  }
  if(!proof){
    console.log(JSON.stringify({needRecovery:item.ordinal,name:item.name,stage:"source",errors:earlyErrors}));
    await waitForMarker("retry-"+item.ordinal);
    fonts=await visit(page,item);
    currentView=item.viewIndex;
    if(item.viewport==="desktop")await setDesktop(page,item);else await setMobile(page,item);
    proof=await sourceEvidence(page,item,fonts);
  }
  if(!seed?.captureId){
    console.log(JSON.stringify({needSeed:item.ordinal,name:item.name}));
    await waitForMarker("seed-"+item.ordinal+".json");
    seed=JSON.parse(await readFile(workspace+"/seed-"+item.ordinal+".json","utf8"));
  }
  const posted=page.waitForResponse(resp=>resp.url()===seed.endpoint&&resp.request().method()==="POST"&&resp.status()!==429,{timeout:140000});
  const [http,execute]=await Promise.allSettled([
    posted,
    page.evaluate(async seed=>{await window.figma.captureOnceForDesign({captureId:seed.captureId,endpoint:seed.endpoint,selector:"body"});},seed)
  ]);
  if(http.status!=="fulfilled"||!http.value.ok()||execute.status!=="fulfilled"){
    const problem={ordinal:item.ordinal,name:item.name,stage:"submit",captureId:seed.captureId,http:http.status==="fulfilled"?http.value.status():null,error:execute.status==="rejected"?safe(execute.reason):http.status==="rejected"?safe(http.reason):null};
    await writeFile(workspace+"/submit-problem.json",JSON.stringify(problem));
    console.log(JSON.stringify({needReconcile:item.ordinal,name:item.name,http:problem.http,error:problem.error}));
    await waitForMarker("reconciled-"+item.ordinal+".json");
    const recovered=JSON.parse(await readFile(workspace+"/reconciled-"+item.ordinal+".json","utf8"));
    assert.ok(recovered.figmaNodeId&&recovered.fileUrl);
    const entry={ordinal:item.ordinal,name:item.name,proof,earlyErrors,...recovered};
    await appendFile(pageLog,JSON.stringify(entry)+"\n");
    receipts.push(entry);
    seed=recovered.nextSeed??null;
    continue;
  }
  const reply=await http.value.json();
  if(reply.error)throw new Error("Figma rejected submitted payload");
  const fileUrl=reply.fileUrl||reply.claimUrl;
  const token=fileUrl?new URL(fileUrl).searchParams.get("node-id"):null;
  const extra=payloadReceipt(http.value,item);
  const entry={ordinal:item.ordinal,name:item.name,proof,earlyErrors,http:http.value.status(),fileUrl,figmaNodeId:token?.replace("-",":")??null,serverKeys:Object.keys(reply),...extra};
  receipts.push(entry);
  await appendFile(pageLog,JSON.stringify(entry)+"\n");
  seed=reply.nextCaptureId?{captureId:reply.nextCaptureId,endpoint:scopedEndpoint(seed.endpoint,reply.nextCaptureId)}:null;
  if(item.ordinal<=3||item.ordinal%5===0||item.ordinal===list.length||!seed){
    console.log(JSON.stringify({captured:item.ordinal,total:list.length,name:item.name,nodeId:entry.figmaNodeId,continuation:Boolean(seed),serverKeys:entry.serverKeys}));
  }
  if(item.ordinal===2){
    await writeFile(workspace+"/checkpoint.json",JSON.stringify(receipts,null,2));
    console.log(JSON.stringify({checkpoint:2,awaitingReadback:true}));
    await waitForMarker("continue");
  }
 }
 assert.equal(receipts.length,list.length);
 console.log(JSON.stringify({finished:receipts.length,browser:browser.version(),complete:true}));
}finally{
 if(context)await context.close();
 await browser.close();
}`.replace("__HELPERS__",helpers);
store("t020Runner",run);
const tmp=load("figmaT017Tmp");
const seed=load("t020Seed");
if(!seed||!run)throw new Error("Full batch is missing its verified run inputs");
const q=s=>"'"+s.replace(/'/g,"'\\''")+"'";
const cmd=`mise exec node@24.22.2 -- node --input-type=module -e ${q(run)} ${q("http://127.0.0.1:"+load("t020Port"))} ${q(tmp+"/t020")} ${q(tmp+"/t018/capture.js")} ${q(JSON.stringify(seed))}`;
const result=await tools.exec_command({cmd,workdir:tmp+"/browser",max_output_tokens:1700,yield_time_ms:1400,tty:true});
store("t020Process",result);
text(result);

async function imageSize(hash){

 }

function withinFrame(n,root){

 if(!b||b.width<0.5||b.height<0.5)return false;
 let left=b.x,top=b.y,right=b.x+b.width,bottom=b.y+b.height;

 return right-left>0.5&&bottom-top>0.5;

 const header=item.viewport==="desktop"?brandRow(root):null;

 tasks.push({item,root,dir,header,tiles,preIssues});
}
if(!dry){
 for(const font of fontRequests.values())await figma.loadFontAsync(font);

 const displayed=headings.some(n=>withinFrame(n,root));
 if(!displayed)notes.push("视口内标题");
 if(!normalize(texts.map(n=>n.characters).join(" ")).includes(normalize(bodyMarker(item))))notes.push("原型正文锚点");
 const menus=root.findAll(n=>n.type==="FRAME"&&n.name==="Navigation - 主导航"&&withinFrame(n,root));
 const directory=root.findAll(n=>n.type==="FRAME"&&n.name==="Navigation - 技能文档目录"&&withinFrame(n,root));
 const drawer=root.findAll(n=>n.type==="FRAME"&&n.name==="Dialog - 技能文档"&&withinFrame(n,root));
 let menuState;
 if(item.viewport==="desktop"){
   const inHeader=menus.length===1?visibleLabels(menus[0],root):new Set();
   menuState=inHeader.has("技能文档总览")?"集合下拉展开":"关闭";
   if(menus.length!==1||inHeader.has("技能文档总览")!==item.dropdown||item.dropdown&&(!inHeader.has("frontend")||!inHeader.has("workflow")))notes.push("桌面下拉状态");
 }else{
   const inMenu=menus.length===1?visibleLabels(menus[0],root):new Set();
   menuState=menus.length===0?"关闭":inMenu.has("技能文档总览")?"展开":"折叠";
   const expected=item.menu==="closed"?"关闭":item.menu==="expanded"?"展开":"折叠";
   if(menuState!==expected||menus.length>1||item.menu!=="closed"&&!inMenu.has("MCP 文档"))notes.push("手机顶部菜单状态");
   if(Boolean(drawer.length)!==item.drawer||drawer.length>1||item.drawer&&Math.abs(drawer[0].width-320)>1)notes.push("手机目录抽屉");
 }
 const expectedDirectory=item.viewport==="desktop"?Boolean(item.skill):Boolean(item.drawer);
 let folderState=[];
 if(expectedDirectory&&directory.length===1){
   const visible=visibleLabels(directory[0],root);
   for(const [f,slugs] of Object.entries(expectedSkills)){
     const n=slugs.filter(label=>visible.has(label)).length;
     if(n>0)folderState.push(f);
     if(n!==(item.folders?.includes(f)?slugs.length:0))notes.push("目录子项 "+f);
   }
 }else if(Boolean(directory.length)!==expectedDirectory||directory.length>1)notes.push("技能目录可见性");
 if(item.path.startsWith("/spec-kit/")){

 }

 const missing=texts.filter(n=>n.hasMissingFont).length;
 if(texts.length===0||layout===0||vectors===0)notes.push("原生图层");
 if(missing)notes.push("缺失字体");
 const canvasNodes=root.findAll(n=>n.name==="Canvas"&&withinFrame(n,root)&&Array.isArray(n.fills)&&n.fills.some(f=>f.type==="IMAGE"));

    }

For EXTERNAL URLs (not localhost): use Playwright MCP to capture — do NOT use 'open' with hash fragments on external sites. Call this tool with a fileKey (no captureId) to get the capture script + a captureId, then poll with the captureId every 5 seconds (up to 10 times) until status is 'completed'. Each capture ID is single-use. The maximum capture size, including serialized images, is 50MB. \\n\\nUSING generate_figma_design WITH use_figma:\\n- For web apps, use BOTH tools in parallel: run this tool (generate_figma_design) to capture a pixel-perfect layout, and use use_figma with search_design_system to build the screen from design system components.\\n- Once both complete, refine the use_figma output to match the pixel-perfect layout from this tool's capture, then delete this tool's output (it was used as a layout reference only).\\n- For non-web apps (e.g. iOS), use use_figma only.\\n- For updating/syncing a page already in Figma, use use_figma only.\\n\\nThe official Figma MCP server. This applies to read-only tasks too. If a new file is needed, call create_new_file first, then create_session with the returned file key. Reuse the returned UUID as the sessionId argument on eligible file tools for subsequent work on that task, including calls to other files.\\n\\nCAPABILITIES:\\n- Read designs FROM Figma into code (get_design_context, get_screenshot, get_metadata, get_figjam)\\n- Write designs INTO Figma from code, intent, or existing components (use_figma, generate_figma_design, create_new_file, upload_assets)\\n- Bridge code and design via Code Connect (get_code_connect_map, add_code_connect_map)\\n- Create diagrams and FigJam content (generate_diagram, get_figjam)\\n\\nWHEN TO USE THESE TOOLS:\\n- The user wants to create, mock up, or generate any UI, screen, component, or design — even if Figma isn't named\\n- The user wants to implement a design as code (design-to-code)\\n- The user wants to push a page, view, or component into Figma (code-to-design)\\n- The user wants to update, sync, or edit an existing Figma file\\n- The user shares a figma.com URL\\n- The user wants to build or extend a design system, design tokens, or component library\\n- The user wants to create a diagram in FigJam\\n\\nSKILLS (Prefer the skills shipped with the Figma plugin on the agent being used. // @exec: {"yield_time_ms": 1000}
const base="/tmp/foundry-figma-t017.ZRjS76/t020";
const args=load("t020CaptureArgs");
const read=()=>tools.exec_command({cmd:`python3 - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,urllib.parse
p=pathlib.Path('${base}')
ids=json.loads((p/'verified-node-ids.json').read_text())
rows=[]
for raw in (p/'capture-receipts.ndjson').read_text().splitlines():
 try:
  row=json.loads(raw)
 except json.JSONDecodeError:
  continue
 token=urllib.parse.urlsplit(row['fileUrl']).path.split('/')[-1]
 rows.append([row['ordinal'],token,row.get('figmaNodeId')])
print(json.dumps([ids,rows]))
PY`,max_output_tokens:6000});
const monitor=String.raw`
async () => {
 let ids={},rowCount=0, issues=[];
 for(let round=0;round<5;round++){
   const source=await read();
   if(source.exit_code!==0)throw new Error(source.output);
   const [existing,rows]=JSON.parse(source.output);
   ids=existing;
   rowCount=rows.length;
   const pending=rows.filter(([i])=>!ids[i]).slice(0,8);
   if(!pending.length)break;
   const polled=await Promise.allSettled(pending.map(async ([ordinal,captureId])=>{
     if(!/^[a-f0-9]{8}(-[a-f0-9]{4}){3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$/i.test(captureId))throw new Error("Invalid receipt identifier");
     const result=await tools.mcp__figma__generate_figma_design({...args,captureId});
     const content=result.content?.map(c=>c.type==="text"?c.text:"").join("\n")??"";
     const link=content.match(/https:\/\/www\.figma\.com\/design\/xd4v3YLbHr6MFrshieoSPs\/[^\s)"']*?[?&]node-id=(\d+)-(\d+)/);
     if(link&&!result.isError)return [ordinal,link[1]+":"+link[2]];
     const status=content.match(/pending|processing|429|rate.limit|error|failed/i)?.[0]??"missing completed link";
     return [ordinal,null,status];
   }));
   for(const [i,result] of polled.entries()){
     if(result.status==="rejected"){issues.push([pending[i][0],"poll rejected"]);continue;}
     const [ordinal,id,status]=result.value;
     if(!id){issues.push([ordinal,status]);continue;}
     if(Object.values(ids).includes(id))throw new Error("Duplicate destination node "+id+" at "+ordinal);
     ids[ordinal]=id;
   }
   const payload=JSON.stringify(ids);
   if(!/^[0-9":,{}]+$/.test(payload))throw new Error("Invalid IDs");
   const saved=await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'\nfrom pathlib import Path\np=Path('"+base+"/verified-node-ids.json')\nnext_path=p.with_suffix('.tmp')\nnext_path.write_text('"+payload+"\\n')\nnext_path.replace(p)\nPY",max_output_tokens:200});
   if(saved.exit_code!==0)throw new Error(saved.output);
   if(issues.some(x=>/429|rate.limit/i.test(x[1])))break;
 }
 return {captured:rowCount,confirmed:Object.keys(ids).length,issues};
}`;
store("t020MonitorCode",monitor);
const results=await Promise.allSettled([
 eval("("+monitor+")")(),
 tools.mcp__figma__use_figma({fileKey:args.fileKey,sessionId:args.sessionId,skillNames:"resource:figma-use",description:"Inspect actual mobile menu text, parent clipping, and bounds",code:`
const p=await figma.getNodeByIdAsync("20:2");await figma.setCurrentPageAsync(p);
const ids=["110:2","111:2","112:2"];
const clean=b=>b?Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(b).map(([k,v])=>[k,Math.round(v)])):null;
const reports=[];
for(const id of ids){
 const root=await figma.getNodeByIdAsync(id);
 if(root?.parent?.id!==p.id)continue;
 const menus=root.findAll(n=>n.type==="FRAME"&&/导航|Menu|Sheet/.test(n.name)).map(n=>[n.id,n.name,clean(n.absoluteBoundingBox)]);
 const entries=root.findAll(n=>n.type==="TEXT"&&/^(技能文档总览|技能文档|MCP 文档|MCP|frontend|workflow|Spec Kit|开发约定)$/.test(n.characters.trim())).map(n=>{
  const t=[];
  for(let a=n;a&&a.id!==root.id;a=a.parent)t.push([a.name,clean(a.absoluteBoundingBox),a.clipsContent,a.visible,a.opacity]);
  return [n.characters,t];
 });
 reports.push({id,name:root.name,bounds:clean(root.absoluteBoundingBox),menus,entries});
}
return {reports};
`})
]);
for(let i=0;i<results.length;i++){
 const x=results[i];
 if(x.status!=="fulfilled"){text({task:i,status:x.status});continue;}
 if(i===1){
  store("t020MobileDiagnosis",x.value);
  const body=x.value.structuredContent??JSON.parse(x.value.content?.[0]?.text??'{}');
  text(body.reports?.map(y=>({id:y.id,bounds:y.bounds,menus:y.menus,entries:y.entries.map(z=>[z[0],z[1].map(v=>[v[0],v[1]?.y,v[1]?.height,v[2]===true])])}))??{error:true});
 } else text(x.value);
}

## 页面转换契约（Figma）

真实原型清单中的每一项必须唯一映射到同一 Figma Design 文件内具名画板；同一次批次启动覆盖选定清单。画板常规文字可修改、布局图层可选择调整，正文与可见导航状态符合原型。字体、图片、3D 与动画的差异逐项记录；替代经设计协作者确认。未取得原型输入或目标文件编辑权限时，此契约状态为缺前置，不作通过判断。
## T019 代表性试转

2026-11-27 使用 T017 的 Make 原型快照和 T018 的采集方式。一次 Playwright 主流程依次启动四个样例，为每项设置实际视口并核对章节或目录状态，调用 Figma 采集脚本的 `captureOnceForDesign`。四次提交均返回 HTTP 200，四个采集编号均取得同一 Design 文件的完成回执。布局调整和命名在四块原生画板上以 Figma 脚本执行。 [实施方案](../implementation/T019.md) · [目标页面 Page 1](https://www.figma.com/design/xd4v3YLbHr6MFrshieoSPs/Untitled?node-id=0-1)

### 实际画板

将四块画板的 Figma 渲染图逐项与同一次浏览器采集保存的参考图对照。各画板均为 `Page 1` 下的原生 FRAME，画板间无重叠。常规文字为有 `characters` 的 TEXT 层，导航和布局含可选择、可调整的原生框架与矢量层。

| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------- | ------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| [首页 Skills · 桌面](https://www.figma.com/design/xd4v3YLbHr6MFrshieoSPs/Untitled?node-id=3-2)   | 1440 × 900 | 49 个文字层，150 个可调整框架或矢量层 | 第一章和两段说明均在视口内，顶部导航关闭，MCP 章在章节容器裁切范围之外 | 原 Three.js 文件夹保留为静帧 |
| [首页 Skills · 手机](https://www.figma.com/design/xd4v3YLbHr6MFrshieoSPs/Untitled?node-id=4-2)   | 390 × 844  | 33 个文字层，132 个可调整框架或矢量层 | 第一章、手机页顶和下方操作区可见，手机全局菜单关闭                     | 原 Three.js 文件夹保留为静帧 |
| [frontend 集合 · 桌面](https://www.figma.com/design/xd4v3YLbHr6MFrshieoSPs/Untitled?node-id=5-2) | 1440 × 900 | 31 个文字层，160 个可调整框架或矢量层 | frontend 选中且列出三个技能，workflow 折叠，集合说明和卡片可见         | 品牌图标和目录图标为矢量层   |
| [frontend 集合 · 手机](https://www.figma.com/design/xd4v3YLbHr6MFrshieoSPs/Untitled?node-id=6-2) | 390 × 844  | 28 个文字层，163 个可调整框架或矢量层 | 左侧抽屉宽 320 像素，frontend 展开、workflow 折叠，背景遮罩保留        | 品牌和目录图标为矢量层       |

### 差异与处理

- 两块桌面画板导入时忽略了顶部容器的居中最大宽度，品牌图标的左边距为 32 像素。按源预览恢复左右各 112 像素，复核了主导航的居中位置。
- 首页纸纹导入时只绘制了左上角的单个纹理块。保留原采集的 180 × 180 像素纹理，恢复图像平铺、原透明度和原混合方式，复核了两个视口的完整纹理。
- 手机集合页导入时按完整文档定高 861 像素。以源视口 390 × 844 裁切，复核了展开抽屉、选中态和遮罩。
- 浏览器在两块首页源画面均为实时 Three.js，Figma 保留了当时的渲染图像。画板中的文件夹是图像层，旋转和章节入场动画在原型中查看。浏览器参考图与导入静帧之间可见连续动画带来的轻微姿态差异。
- 英文首页标题实际使用 `Instrument Serif`，品牌及集合标题使用 `Geist`，导入文字保留这些字体。首页中文标题的源浏览器使用 `Noto Serif SC`，导入时附在 `Instrument Serif` 的回退字形上。已将两处标题的原生文字恢复为 `Noto Serif SC Medium`（字重 500），并核对了衬线字形。四块画板的 Figma 字体缺失计数均为 0。
- 源浏览器的中文正文和目录实际使用 `Source Han Sans CN`，Figma 目标的可用字体中没有该字体。2026-11-27 用户回复「中文字体嘛，确认吧，项目中可以使用unocss的字体来处理」，确认试转画板采用 `Noto Sans SC`，并允许站点实现时通过 UnoCSS 处理字体。已在四块画板的 65 个原生文字层、73 个中文字体区间应用 `Noto Sans SC`。其中 3 个源半粗体区间使用目标可用的 Bold 字重。复核四块 Figma 渲染，第 1 块的桌面首页正文仍有一处换行差异，内容完整，视口和导航状态核对通过。 [站点 UnoCSS 配置](../../../../apps/docs/uno.config.ts)

1` 下的原生 FRAME，画板间无重叠。常规文字为有 `characters` 的 TEXT 层，导航和布局含可选择、可调整的原生框架与矢量层。\n\n| 画板                                                                                             | 最终视口   | 可编辑性                              | 正文与导航状态                                                         | 图片和模型                   |\n| |\n\n### 差异与处理\n\n- 两块桌面画板导入时忽略了顶部容器的居中最大宽度，品牌图标的左边距为 32 像素。按源预览恢复左右各 112 像素，复核了主导航的居中位置。\n- 首页纸纹导入时只绘制了左上角的单个纹理块。保留原采集的 180 × 180 像素纹理，恢复图像平铺、原透明度和原混合方式，复核了两个视口的完整纹理。\n- 手机集合页导入时按完整文档定高 861 像素。以源视口 390 × 844 裁切，复核了展开抽屉、选中态和遮罩。\n- 浏览器在两块首页源画面均为实时 Three.js，Figma 保留了当时的渲染图像。画板中的文件夹是图像层，旋转和章节入场动画在原型中查看。浏览器参考图与导入静帧之间可见连续动画带来的轻微姿态差异。\n- 英文首页标题实际使用 `Instrument Serif`，品牌及集合标题使用 // @exec: {"yield_time_ms": 1000}
const entries=load("t020FullEntries");
const args=load("t020CaptureArgs");
const template=load("t020NormalizeAndAudit");
if(entries.length!==165||load("t020BrowserCompletion")?.exit_code!==0)throw new Error("A complete batch is required");
const quote=s=>"'"+s.replaceAll("'","'\\''")+"'";
const base="/tmp/foundry-figma-t017.ZRjS76/t020";
const persist=async (path,data)=>{
 const payload=JSON.stringify(data);
 const py="from pathlib import Path; import sys; p=Path(sys.argv[1]); q=p.with_suffix('.tmp'); q.write_text(sys.argv[2]+'\\n',encoding='utf-8'); q.replace(p)";
 const r=await tools.exec_command({cmd:`python3 -c ${quote(py)} ${quote(path)} ${quote(payload)}`,max_output_tokens:150});
 if(r.exit_code!==0)throw new Error(r.output);
};
let accumulated=load("t020NormalizationReports")??[];
for(let offset=accumulated.length;offset<entries.length;){
 const chunk=entries.slice(offset,offset+(offset===0?10:18));
 const code=template.replace("__ITEMS__",JSON.stringify(chunk)).replace("__PAGE_ID__",JSON.stringify("20:2")).replace("__DRY__","false").replace("__STRICT__","true").replace("__EXPORT__","false");
 const response=await tools.mcp__figma__use_figma({fileKey:args.fileKey,sessionId:args.sessionId,skillNames:"resource:figma-use,resource:figma-generate-design",description:`Normalize full-batch native artboards ${chunk[0].ordinal}–${chunk.at(-1).ordinal}`,code});
 let outcome;
 try{outcome=response.structuredContent??JSON.parse(response.content?.[0]?.text??"{}");}catch{}
 if(response.isError||!Array.isArray(outcome?.report)){
   store("t020NormalizationProblem",{start:chunk[0].ordinal,stop:chunk.at(-1).ordinal,response});
   text({start:chunk[0].ordinal,stop:chunk.at(-1).ordinal,isError:response.isError,details:response.content?.[0]?.text?.slice(0,900)});
   break;
 }
 if(outcome.report.length!==chunk.length||outcome.report.some((r,i)=>r.ordinal!==chunk[i].ordinal||r.id!==chunk[i].id))throw new Error("Unexpected batch membership");
 accumulated=[...accumulated,...outcome.report];
 await persist(base+"/normalization-results.json",accumulated);
 store("t020NormalizationReports",accumulated);
 const issues=outcome.report.filter(r=>r.notes.length).map(r=>[r.ordinal,r.notes]);
 text({normalized:accumulated.length,clean:accumulated.filter(r=>!r.notes.length).length,issues,changedTextLayers:outcome.report.reduce((n,r)=>n+r.edited,0)});
 offset=accumulated.length;
 if(issues.length||offset===10)await yield_control();
 if(issues.length)break;
 if(offset<entries.length&&offset%36===10)await yield_control();
}

// @exec: {"yield_time_ms": 1000}
const args=load("t020CaptureArgs");
const entries=load("t020FullEntries");
const template=load("t020NormalizeAndAudit");
const base="/tmp/foundry-figma-t017.ZRjS76/t020";
const quote=s=>"'"+s.replaceAll("'","'\\''")+"'";
const persist=async (path,data)=>{
 const payload=JSON.stringify(data);
 const py="from pathlib import Path; import sys; p=Path(sys.argv[1]); q=p.with_suffix('.tmp'); q.write_text(sys.argv[2]+'\\n',encoding='utf-8'); q.replace(p)";
 const r=await tools.exec_command({cmd:`python3 -c ${quote(py)} ${quote(path)} ${quote(payload)}`,max_output_tokens:150});
 if(r.exit_code!==0)throw new Error(r.output);
};
const audit=async()=>{
 let accumulated=load("t020FinalAudit")??[];
 for(let offset=accumulated.length;offset<entries.length;offset=accumulated.length){
  const chunk=entries.slice(offset,offset+18);
  const code=template.replace("__ITEMS__",JSON.stringify(chunk)).replace("__PAGE_ID__",JSON.stringify("20:2")).replace("__DRY__","true").replace("__STRICT__","true").replace("__EXPORT__","true");
  const response=await tools.mcp__figma__use_figma({fileKey:args.fileKey,sessionId:args.sessionId,skillNames:"resource:figma-use",description:`Independently audit native state and PNG rendering for artboards ${chunk[0].ordinal}–${chunk.at(-1).ordinal}`,code});
  let outcome;
  try{outcome=response.structuredContent??JSON.parse(response.content?.[0]?.text??"{}");}catch{}
  if(response.isError||!Array.isArray(outcome?.report)){
    store("t020FinalAuditProblem",{start:chunk[0].ordinal,stop:chunk.at(-1).ordinal,response});
    return {offset,error:response.content?.[0]?.text?.slice(0,700)};
  }
  if(outcome.mutatedNodeIds?.length||outcome.report.length!==chunk.length||outcome.report.some((r,i)=>r.ordinal!==chunk[i].ordinal||r.id!==chunk[i].id))throw new Error("Native readback mismatch");
  accumulated=[...accumulated,...outcome.report];
  await persist(base+"/native-render-audit.json",accumulated);
  store("t020FinalAudit",accumulated);
  if(accumulated.length%54===0||accumulated.length===165)notify({readBack:accumulated.length,png:accumulated.filter(r=>r.rendered&&!r.notes.some(n=>n.includes("PNG"))).length,issues:accumulated.filter(r=>r.notes.length).map(r=>[r.ordinal,r.notes])});
 }
 return {total:accumulated.length,issues:accumulated.filter(r=>r.notes.length),allPng:accumulated.filter(r=>r.rendered).length};
};
const proof=async()=>{
 const x=await tools.exec_command({cmd:`python3 - <<'PY'
import collections,hashlib,json,pathlib,struct
p=pathlib.Path('${base}')
manifest=json.loads((p/'manifest.json').read_text())
assert isinstance(manifest,list), type(manifest)
rows=[json.loads(x) for x in (p/'capture-receipts.ndjson').read_text().splitlines()]
counts=collections.Counter()
for m,r in zip(manifest,rows,strict=True):
 n=m['ordinal']; proof=r['proof']
 assert n==r['ordinal'] and m['name']==r['name'] and r['http']==200, n
 assert (r['viewport']['width'],r['viewport']['height'])==(m['width'],m['height']), n
 assert proof['path']==m['path'] and proof['heading']==m['heading'] and proof['fontReady'] and len(proof['contentHash'])==64, (n,proof['path'],proof['heading'])
 assert proof['drawer']==bool(m['drawer']), (n,proof['drawer'])
 expected_menu=m['menu'] if m['viewport']=='mobile' else ('desktop-open' if m['dropdown'] else 'desktop-closed')
 counts[f"{m['viewport']}/{proof['menu']}"]+=1
 if m['viewport']=='mobile':
  assert proof['menu']==expected_menu,(n,proof['menu'],expected_menu)
 assert set(proof['folders'] or [])==set(m['folders'] or []),(n,proof['folders'], m['folders'])
 b=(p/f'{n:03d}-source.png').read_bytes()
 assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==proof['referenceSha256'], n
 assert b[:8]==bytes([137,80,78,71,13,10,26,10]) and struct.unpack('>II',b[16:24])==(m['width'],m['height']), n
 assert len(r['payloadSha256'])==64 and r['textNodes']>0, n
 if r['earlyErrors']:
  counts['sourceEarlyErrors']+=1
 counts[(proof.get('modelStatus') or '').endswith('Three.js') and 'live' or 'nonmodel']+=1
print(json.dumps({'count':len(rows),'counts':dict(counts),'default':sum(x['name'].endswith(' · 默认') for x in manifest),'views':len({x['view'] for x in manifest})},ensure_ascii=False))
PY`,max_output_tokens:1000});
 store("t020SourceProofCheck",x);
 return x;
};
const screenshot=async()=>{
 const r=await tools.mcp__figma__get_screenshot({fileKey:args.fileKey,nodeId:entries[0].id,sessionId:args.sessionId,maxDimension:680});
 store("t020ScreenshotProbe",r);
 const safe=r.content?.map(c=>{
  if(c.type!=="text")return {type:c.type};
  let parsed;try{parsed=JSON.parse(c.text);}catch{}
  return parsed?{type:c.type,keys:Object.keys(parsed),originalWidth:parsed.original_width,originalHeight:parsed.original_height}:c.text.replace(/https?:\/\/[^\s'"\])>]+/g,"<url>").slice(0,480);
 });
 return {isError:r.isError,content:safe};
};
const results=await Promise.allSettled([audit(),proof(),screenshot()]);
for(const x of results)text(x.status==="fulfilled"?x.value:{error:x.reason?.message});

// @exec: {"yield_time_ms": 1000}
const args=load("t020CaptureArgs");
const entries=load("t020FullEntries");
const base="/tmp/foundry-figma-t017.ZRjS76/t020";
const quote=s=>"'"+s.replaceAll("'","'\\''")+"'";
const additional=new Set([2,4,8,9,86,87,89,90,94,95,96,97]);
const samples=entries.filter(m=>m.name.endsWith(" · 默认")||additional.has(m.ordinal));
store("t020VisualSamples",samples.map(m=>m.ordinal));
const screenshot=async (item,index)=>{
 for(let attempt=0;attempt<2;attempt++){
  const response=item.ordinal===1&&!attempt?load("t020ScreenshotProbe"):await tools.mcp__figma__get_screenshot({fileKey:args.fileKey,nodeId:item.id,sessionId:args.sessionId,maxDimension:680});
  let img;
  try{img=JSON.parse(response.content[0].text);}catch{}
  if(response?.isError||!img?.image_url){
    if(attempt===0){await new Promise(done=>setTimeout(done,3500));continue;}
    return {ordinal:item.ordinal,failure:"screenshot metadata unavailable"};
  }
  if(img.original_width!==item.width||img.original_height!==item.height)return {ordinal:item.ordinal,failure:"unexpected canvas dimensions"};
  const url=new URL(img.image_url);
  if(url.protocol!=="https:")return {ordinal:item.ordinal,failure:"unexpected screenshot URL protocol"};
  const path=`${base}/${String(item.ordinal).padStart(3,"0")}-figma.png`;
  const image=await tools.exec_command({cmd:`curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 1 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 6 --max-time 25 --output ${quote(path)} ${quote(url.href)}`,max_output_tokens:200,yield_time_ms:24000});
  if(image.exit_code===0)return {ordinal:item.ordinal,file:path,w:img.width,h:img.height};
  if(image.session_id){
   const continued=await tools.write_stdin({session_id:image.session_id,chars:"",yield_time_ms:5000,max_output_tokens:120});
   if(continued.exit_code===0)return {ordinal:item.ordinal,file:path,w:img.width,h:img.height};
  }
 }
 return {ordinal:item.ordinal,failure:"PNG download failed"};
};
const fetch=async()=>{
 const output=[];
 for(let i=0;i<samples.length;i+=6){
   const group=samples.slice(i,i+6);
   const results=await Promise.allSettled(group.map(screenshot));
   output.push(...results.map((r,index)=>r.status==="fulfilled"?r.value:{ordinal:group[index].ordinal,failure:"screenshot request did not complete"}));
   if(output.length===24||output.length===samples.length)notify({visualPngs:output.filter(o=>o.file).length,samples:samples.length,issues:output.filter(o=>o.failure)});
 }
 store("t020VisualOutput",output);
 return {pngs:output.filter(o=>o.file).length,samples:output.length,issues:output.filter(o=>o.failure)};
};
const verify=async()=>{
 const x=await tools.exec_command({cmd:`python3 - <<'PY'
import collections,hashlib,json,pathlib,struct
p=pathlib.Path('${base}')
manifest=json.loads((p/'manifest.json').read_text())
rows=[json.loads(x) for x in (p/'capture-receipts.ndjson').read_text().splitlines()]
counts=collections.Counter()
desktop_states=collections.defaultdict(set)
for m,r in zip(manifest,rows,strict=True):
 n=m['ordinal']; proof=r['proof']
 assert n==r['ordinal'] and m['name']==r['name'] and r['http']==200, n
 assert (r['viewport']['width'],r['viewport']['height'])==(m['width'],m['height']), n
 assert proof['path']==m['path'] and proof['heading']==m['heading'] and proof['fontReady'] and len(proof['contentHash'])==64, (n,proof['path'],proof['heading'])
 assert bool(proof.get('drawer'))==bool(m.get('drawer')), (n,proof.get('drawer'))
 counts[f"{m['viewport']}/{proof.get('menu')}"]+=1
 if m['viewport']=='mobile':
  assert proof['menu']==m['menu'],(n,proof['menu'],m['menu'])
 else:
  desktop_states[m['dropdown']].add(proof.get('menu'))
 assert set(proof.get('folders') or [])==set(m.get('folders') or []),(n,proof.get('folders'), m.get('folders'))
 b=(p/f'{n:03d}-source.png').read_bytes()
 assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==proof['referenceSha256'], n
 assert b[:8]==bytes([137,80,78,71,13,10,26,10]) and struct.unpack('>II',b[16:24])==(m['width'],m['height']), n
 assert len(r['payloadSha256'])==64 and r['textNodes']>0, n
 if r['earlyErrors']:
  counts['sourceEarlyErrors']+=1
 counts[(proof.get('modelStatus') or '').endswith('Three.js') and 'live' or 'nonmodel']+=1
print(json.dumps({'count':len(rows),'counts':dict(counts),'desktopMenu':{k:sorted(v) for k,v in desktop_states.items()},'default':sum(x['name'].endswith(' · 默认') for x in manifest),'views':len({x['view'] for x in manifest})},ensure_ascii=False))
PY`,max_output_tokens:700});
 store("t020SourceProofCheck",x);
 return x;
};
const out=await Promise.allSettled([fetch(),verify()]);
for(const x of out)text(x.value??{error:x.reason?.message});

// @exec: {"yield_time_ms": 1000}
const scope=load("t020CaptureArgs");
const items=load("t020FullEntries");
const base="/tmp/foundry-figma-t017.ZRjS76/t020";
const quote=s=>"'"+s.replaceAll("'","'\\''")+"'";
const selected=new Set(load("t020VisualSamples"));
const runShots=async()=>{
 const samples=items.filter(m=>selected.has(m.ordinal)&&m.ordinal!==1);
 const fetch=async (m)=>{
  for(let attempt=0;attempt<2;attempt++){
   const response=await tools.mcp__figma__get_screenshot({fileKey:scope.fileKey,nodeId:m.id,sessionId:scope.sessionId,maxDimension:680});
   let img;try{img=JSON.parse(response.content[0].text);}catch{}
   if(response.isError||typeof img?.image_url!=="string"||!/^https:\/\/[^\s]+$/.test(img.image_url)){
    if(!attempt){await new Promise(done=>setTimeout(done,4100));continue;}
    return {ordinal:m.ordinal,error:"missing image URL"};
   }
   if(img.original_width!==m.width||img.original_height!==m.height)return {ordinal:m.ordinal,error:"screenshot dimensions"};
   const destination=`${base}/${String(m.ordinal).padStart(3,"0")}-figma.png`;
   const cli=await tools.exec_command({cmd:`curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 1 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 6 --max-time 20 --output ${quote(destination)} ${quote(img.image_url)}`,max_output_tokens:80,yield_time_ms:27000});
   if(cli.exit_code===0)return {ordinal:m.ordinal,downloaded:true,width:img.width,height:img.height};
  }
  return {ordinal:m.ordinal,error:"image download"};
 };
 const output=[];
 for(let i=0;i<samples.length;i+=7){
   const group=samples.slice(i,i+7);
   const out=await Promise.allSettled(group.map(fetch));
   output.push(...out.map((x,k)=>x.status==="fulfilled"?x.value:{ordinal:group[k].ordinal,error:(x.reason?.name??"request failure")}));
   store("t020VisualOutput",output);
   if(output.length===21||output.length===samples.length)notify({downloaded:output.filter(o=>o.downloaded).length,requested:output.length,errors:output.filter(o=>o.error)});
 }
 return output.filter(o=>o.error);
};
const local=tools.exec_command({cmd:`file ${base}/001-figma.png
command -v magick convert montage ffmpeg uv
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json,collections,itertools
p=Path('${base}'); m=json.loads((p/'manifest.json').read_text()); a=json.loads((p/'native-render-audit.json').read_text()); r=json.loads((p/'normalization-results.json').read_text()); rcv=[json.loads(x) for x in (p/'capture-receipts.ndjson').read_text().splitlines()]
assert len(m)==len(a)==len(r)==len(rcv)==165
assert len({x['id'] for x in a})==len({x['name'] for x in a})==165
for x,y in zip(m,a,strict=True):
 assert x['name']==y['name'] and all(x[k]==y[k] for k in ('x','y')) and not y['notes'] and y['missing']==0 and y['rendered'], (x['ordinal'],y)
for f,g in itertools.combinations(a,2):
 assert not(f['x']<g['x']+g['w'] and g['x']<f['x']+f['w'] and f['y']<g['y']+g['h'] and g['y']<f['y']+f['h']),(f['ordinal'],g['ordinal'])
print('source desktop proof keys',list(rcv[0]['proof']))
print('changed text',sum(x['edited'] for x in r),'font ranges',sum(x['editedSpans'] for x in r),'bold ranges',sum(x['strongSpans'] for x in r),'model images',[(q['ordinal'],len(q['model'])) for q in a if q['model']])
print('native readback',len(a),'text range',min(x['texts'] for x in a),max(x['texts'] for x in a),'layout range',min(x['layout'] for x in a),max(x['layout'] for x in a),'png bytes range',min(x['rendered']['bytes'] for x in a),max(x['rendered']['bytes'] for x in a))
PY`,max_output_tokens:1000}).then(x=>{store("t020FinalNativeGeometry",x);notify(x.output);return {local:x.exit_code};});

import json, pathlib
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw,ImageFont,ImageChops,ImageFilter,ImageStat
p=pathlib.Path('.')
selected=${JSON.stringify(list)}

items=[x for x in manifest if x['ordinal'] in selected]
font=ImageFont.load_default(size=14)
metrics=[]
for viewport, w, columns, per_sheet in [('desktop',330,2,8),('mobile',200,3,6)]:
 sample=[x for x in items if x['viewport']==viewport]
 for offset in range(0,len(sample),per_sheet):
  group=sample[offset:offset+per_sheet]
  height=round(w*group[0]['height']/group[0]['width'])
  rows=(len(group)+columns-1)//columns
  cell_w=w*2+32
  cell_h=height+38
  sheet=Image.new('RGB',(columns*cell_w,rows*cell_h),(234,232,228))
  draw=ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
  for index,x in enumerate(group):
   n=x['ordinal']
   src=Image.open(p/f'{n:03d}-source.png').convert('RGBA')
   fig=Image.open(p/f'{n:03d}-figma.png').convert('RGBA')
   assert src.size==(x['width'],x['height']) and abs(fig.height/fig.width-src.height/src.width)<0.01,(n,src.size,fig.size)
   origin_x=(index%columns)*cell_w+12
   origin_y=(index//columns)*cell_h+10
   if viewport=='desktop':
    state='dropdown open' if x.get('dropdown') else 'default'
    if x.get('folders'):
     state+=', '+','.join(x['folders'])
   else:
    state=x['menu'] if not x.get('drawer') else 'drawer '+','.join(x.get('folders',[]))
   draw.text((origin_x,origin_y),f"{n:03d}  {x['path']}  {state}",font=font,fill=(29,27,25))
   for j,img in enumerate([src,fig]):
    tile=img.resize((w,height),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    sheet.paste(tile,(origin_x+j*(w+8),origin_y+22),tile)
   sz=(160,round(160*height/w))
   def flatten(img):

   metrics.append([n,state,round(sum(ImageStat.Stat(diff).mean)/3,2)])
  path=p/f'visual-{viewport}-{offset//per_sheet+1}.png'
  sheet.save(path)

assert len(metrics)==len(selected)

## 工具调用 `exec` · `call_fb9831194a6547de97d40c04f46458a4`

- 来源定位：字节 17915421

~~~text
工作目录：/home/ena/workspace/ena/agent-foundry/feature/init
// @exec: {"yield_time_ms": 1000}
const base="/tmp/foundry-figma-t017.ZRjS76/t020";
const selected=load("t020VisualSamples");
const cmd=`uv run --no-project --with Pillow python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw,ImageFont,ImageChops,ImageFilter,ImageStat
p=pathlib.Path('${base}')
selected=${JSON.stringify(selected)}
items=[x for x in json.loads((p/'manifest.json').read_text()) if x['ordinal'] in selected]
font=ImageFont.load_default(size=14)
metrics=[]
for viewport,w,columns,per_sheet in [('desktop',330,2,8),('mobile',200,3,6)]:
 sample=[x for x in items if x['viewport']==viewport]
 for offset in range(0,len(sample),per_sheet):
  group=sample[offset:offset+per_sheet]
  height=round(w*group[0]['height']/group[0]['width'])
  rows=(len(group)+columns-1)//columns
  cell_w=w*2+32
  cell_h=height+38
  sheet=Image.new('RGB',(columns*cell_w,rows*cell_h),(234,232,228))
  draw=ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
  for i,x in enumerate(group):
   n=x['ordinal']
   src=Image.open(p/f'{n:03d}-source.png').convert('RGBA')
   fig=Image.open(p/f'{n:03d}-figma.png').convert('RGBA')
   assert src.size==(x['width'],x['height']) and abs(fig.height/fig.width-src.height/src.width)<0.01
   ox=(i%columns)*cell_w+12
   oy=(i//columns)*cell_h+10
   if viewport=='desktop':
    state='dropdown open' if x.get('dropdown') else 'default'
    if x.get('folders'): state+=', '+','.join(x['folders'])
   else:
    state=x['menu'] if not x.get('drawer') else 'drawer '+','.join(x.get('folders',[]))
   draw.text((ox,oy),f"{n:03d}  {x['path']}  {state}",font=font,fill=(29,27,25))
   for j,img in enumerate((src,fig)):
    tile=img.resize((w,height),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    sheet.paste(tile,(ox+j*(w+8),oy+22),tile)
   sz=(160,round(160*height/w))
   def flatten(img):
    flat=Image.new('RGBA',sz,'white')
    flat.alpha_composite(img.resize(sz,Image.Resampling.LANCZOS))
    return flat.convert('RGB').filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(1.1))
   diff=ImageChops.difference(flatten(src),flatten(fig))
   metrics.append([n,state,round(sum(ImageStat.Stat(diff).mean)/3,2)])
  path=p/f'visual-{viewport}-{offset//per_sheet+1}.png'
  sheet.save(path)
  print(path.name,len(group),sheet.size)
assert len(metrics)==len(selected)
(p/'visual-metrics.json').write_text(json.dumps(metrics,ensure_ascii=False)+'\\n')
print('largest thumbnail differences',sorted(metrics,key=lambda x:-x[2])[:14])
PY`;
store("t020SheetCommand",cmd);
const x=await tools.exec_command({cmd,max_output_tokens:1800,yield_time_ms:10000});
text(x);

~~~

        {items.map((item) => {
          const active = isPathActive(pathname, item.match)
          return (
            <li key={item.match} className="relative flex h-full items-center">
              {item.children ? (
                <NavDropdown item={item} active={active} pathname={pathname} />
              ) : (
                <Link to={item.to} aria-current={active ? 'true' : undefined} className={topItemClass(active)}>
                  {item.label}
                </Link>
              )}
              {active && <span aria-hidden className="absolute inset-x-3 -bottom-px h-0.5 rounded-full bg-primary" />}
            </li>
          )
        })}
      </ul>
    </nav>
  )
}

/** Hover/click dropdown — the `children` content of a horizontal <UNavigationMenu> item. */
function NavDropdown({ item, active, pathname }: { item: NavItem; active: boolean; pathname: string }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null)
  const hoverTimer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined)
  const openedByHoverAt = useRef(0)
  const panelId = useId()

  useEffect(() => {
    setOpen(false)
  }, [pathname])

  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(hoverTimer.current), [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return
    const onPointerDown = (event: PointerEvent) => {
      if (!rootRef.current?.contains(event.target as Node)) setOpen(false)
    }
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key !== 'Escape') return
      setOpen(false)
      triggerRef.current?.focus()
    }
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown)
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown)
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown)
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown)
    }
  }, [open])

  const schedule = (next: boolean, delay: number) => {
    window.clearTimeout(hoverTimer.current)
    hoverTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      if (next) openedByHoverAt.current = Date.now()
      setOpen(next)
    }, delay)
  }

  return (
    <div
      ref={rootRef}
      className="relative flex h-full items-center"
      onPointerEnter={(event) => event.pointerType === 'mouse' && schedule(true, 60)}
      onPointerLeave={(event) => event.pointerType === 'mouse' && schedule(false, 180)}
      onBlur={(event) => {
        if (!rootRef.current?.contains(event.relatedTarget as Node | null)) setOpen(false)
      }}
    >
      <button
        ref={triggerRef}
        type="button"
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-controls={panelId}
        onClick={() => {
          window.clearTimeout(hoverTimer.current)
          // A click right after hover-open keeps the panel open instead of toggling it shut.
          if (open && Date.now() - openedByHoverAt.current < 700) return
          setOpen((value) => !value)
        }}
        className={topItemClass(active)}
      >
        {item.label}
        <ChevronDown aria-hidden className={cn('size-3.5 transition-transform duration-200', open && 'rotate-180')} />
      </button>

      <div
        id={panelId}
        inert={!open}
        className={cn(
          'absolute top-full left-1/2 z-10 w-[22rem] -translate-x-1/2 pt-1.5 transition-[opacity,translate,visibility] duration-200 ease-out',
          open ? 'visible translate-y-0 opacity-100' : 'invisible -translate-y-1 opacity-0',
        )}
      >
        <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-default shadow-xl ring shadow-stone-900/8 ring-default">
          <div className="p-1.5">
            <p className="px-2.5 pt-2 pb-1 text-xs font-medium text-dimmed">技能集合</p>
            <ul>
              {item.children?.map((child) => {
                const childActive = isPathActive(pathname, child.match)
                const Icon = child.icon ?? FolderClosed
                return (
                  <li key={child.to}>
                    <Link
                      to={child.to}
                      onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
                      aria-current={childActive ? 'true' : undefined}
                      className={cn('group flex items-start gap-3 rounded-md p-2.5 transition-colors', childActive ? 'bg-primary/10' : 'hover:bg-elevated/70')}
                    >
                      <span
                        className={cn(
                          'flex size-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md ring transition-colors',
                          childActive ? 'bg-default text-primary ring-primary/25' : 'bg-muted text-muted ring-default group-hover:text-primary',
                        )}
                      >
                        <Icon aria-hidden className="size-4.5" />
                      </span>
                      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <span className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-2">
                          <span className={cn('text-sm font-semibold', childActive ? 'text-primary' : 'text-highlighted')}>{child.label}</span>
                          <span className="text-[11px] text-dimmed">{child.badge}</span>
                        </span>
                        <span className="mt-0.5 block text-xs leading-5 text-muted">{child.description}</span>
                      </span>
                    </Link>
                  </li>
                )
              })}
            </ul>
          </div>
          <div className="border-t border-default bg-muted p-1.5">
            <Link
              to={item.to}
              onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
              className="group flex items-center justify-between rounded-md px-2.5 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-toned transition-colors hover:bg-elevated/70 hover:text-highlighted"
            >
              技能文档总览
              <ArrowRight aria-hidden className="size-4 text-dimmed transition group-hover:translate-x-0.5 group-hover:text-primary" />
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

  return {ordinal:item.ordinal,path};

 store("t020DropdownVisualProof",value);
 return value;
})();
const rest=(async()=>{
 const names=["visual-desktop-2.png","visual-desktop-3.png","visual-mobile-3.png","visual-mobile-4.png"];
 const q=await Promise.allSettled(names.map(name=>tools.view_image({path:base+"/"+name})));
 for(let i=0;i<q.length;i++)if(q[i].status==="fulfilled"){text(names[i]);image(q[i].value.image_url);}
 return q.filter(x=>x.status==="fulfilled").length;
})();
const z=await Promise.allSettled([browserWork,shots,rest]);
for(const x of z)text(x.status==="fulfilled"?x.value:{error:x.reason?.message});

// @exec: {"yield_time_ms": 1000}
const entries=load("t020FullEntries");
const scope=load("t020CaptureArgs");
const base="/tmp/foundry-figma-t017.ZRjS76/t020";
const quote=s=>"'"+s.replaceAll("'","'\\''")+"'";
const validate=async()=>{
 const candidates=entries.filter(i=>i.dropdown);
 const scanned=[];
 for(let i=0;i<candidates.length;i+=14){
  const slice=candidates.slice(i,i+14);
  const code=load("t020NormalizeAndAudit").replace("__ITEMS__",JSON.stringify(slice)).replace("__PAGE_ID__",JSON.stringify("20:2")).replace("__DRY__","true").replace("__STRICT__","true").replace("__EXPORT__","true").replace('if(!displayed)notes.push("视口内标题");',`if(!displayed)notes.push("视口内标题");
  const nav=root.findOne(n=>n.type==="FRAME"&&n.name==="Navigation - 主导航");
  const label=nav?.findOne(n=>n.type==="TEXT"&&n.characters.trim()==="技能文档总览");
  let panel,header;
  for(let node=label?.parent;node&&node.id!==root.id;node=node.parent){
    if(!panel&&node.type==="FRAME"&&node.layoutPositioning==="ABSOLUTE")panel=node;
    if(node.type==="FRAME"&&node.name==="Header")header=node;
  }
  if(!panel||panel.opacity!==1||header?.parent?.itemReverseZIndex!==true||header.parent.children[0]?.id!==header.id)notes.push("顶部菜单叠放和透明度");`);
  const r=await tools.mcp__figma__use_figma({fileKey:scope.fileKey,sessionId:scope.sessionId,skillNames:"resource:figma-use",description:"Read back restored desktop menu stacking and export the adjusted artboards",code});
  const x=r.structuredContent??JSON.parse(r.content?.[0]?.text??"{}");
  if(r.isError||x.report?.length!==slice.length||x.mutatedNodeIds?.length)throw new Error("Desktop menu verification could not read the expected artboards");
  scanned.push(...x.report);
 }
 store("t020AcceptedDropdownReports",scanned);
 return {verified:scanned.length,issues:scanned.filter(r=>r.notes.length).map(r=>[r.ordinal,r.notes])};
};
const updatedShots=async()=>{
 const chosen=entries.filter(m=>[2,4,8].includes(m.ordinal));
 const results=await Promise.allSettled(chosen.map(async item=>{
   const r=await tools.mcp__figma__get_screenshot({fileKey:scope.fileKey,nodeId:item.id,sessionId:scope.sessionId,maxDimension:680});
   const img=JSON.parse(r.content[0].text);
   if(img.original_width!==item.width||img.original_height!==item.height||!/^https:\/\/[^\s]+$/.test(img.image_url))throw new Error("Unexpected post-fix screenshot metadata");
   const path=`${base}/${String(item.ordinal).padStart(3,"0")}-figma-final.png`;
   const file=await tools.exec_command({cmd:`curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 1 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 6 --max-time 20 --output ${quote(path)} ${quote(img.image_url)}`,max_output_tokens:150,yield_time_ms:27000});
   if(file.exit_code!==0)throw new Error("Failed to download after-fix PNG");
   return {ordinal:item.ordinal,path};
 }));
 const out=results.map(x=>x.value??{error:x.reason?.message});
 store("t020UpdatedSamplePNGs",out);
 return out;
};
const stable=async()=>{
 const last=load("t020StableSequential");
 const r=await tools.write_stdin({session_id:last.session_id,chars:"",yield_time_ms:5000,max_output_tokens:2000});
 store("t020StableSequentialPoll",r);
 return {exit:r.exit_code,session:r.session_id,output:r.output.slice(0,2100)};
};
const done=await Promise.allSettled([validate(),updatedShots(),stable()]);
for(const j of done)text(j.value??{error:j.reason?.message});

~~~

if(png.subarray(0,8).join(\",\")!==\"137,80,78,71,13,10,26,10\"||w!==240||Math.abs(h-240*item.height/item.width)>1||png.length<150)row.notes.push(\"Figma PNG 渲染尺寸\");\n     }catch(error){\n       row.notes.push(\"Figma PNG 渲染失败\");\n     }\n   }));\n }\n}\nreturn {mutatedNodeIds:[...changed],report};"
}

if(!cmd.includes("hashlib.sha256(reference")||!cmd.includes("-figma-final.png"))throw new Error("Final source proof missing");
const render=async()=>{
 const made=await tools.exec_command({cmd,max_output_tokens:1500,yield_time_ms:10000});
 if(made.exit_code!==0)throw new Error(made.output);
 text(made.output);
 const images=["visual-settled-desktop-1.png","visual-settled-mobile-1.png","visual-settled-mobile-2.png"];
 const shown=await Promise.allSettled(images.map(f=>tools.view_image({path:base+"/"+f})));
 for(let i=0;i<shown.length;i++){if(shown[i].status==="fulfilled"){text(images[i]);image(shown[i].value.image_url);}else throw new Error(shown[i].reason?.message);}
 store("t020SettledSheets",images);
 return {checked:stable.length};
};
const scopeCheck=async()=>{
 const o=await tools.mcp__figma__use_figma({fileKey:scope.fileKey,sessionId:scope.sessionId,skillNames:"resource:figma-use",description:"Verify all final named native artboards and pilot page IDs",code:`
const full=await figma.getNodeByIdAsync("20:2");
const pilot=await figma.getNodeByIdAsync("0:1");
await figma.setCurrentPageAsync(pilot);
const old=pilot.children.map(n=>n.id);
await figma.setCurrentPageAsync(full);
const expected=${JSON.stringify(entries.map(e=>[e.id,e.name,e.width,e.height]))};
const frames=new Map(full.children.map(n=>[n.id,n]));
const bad=expected.filter(([id,name,w,h])=>{const n=frames.get(id);return n?.type!=="FRAME"||n.name!==name||n.width!==w||n.height!==h||n.clipsContent!==true;}).map(m=>m[0]);
return {page:full.name,count:full.children.length,distinctNames:new Set(full.children.map(n=>n.name)).size,old,bad};
`});
 const x=o.structuredContent??JSON.parse(o.content?.[0]?.text??"{}");
 store("t020LatestFigmaScope",x);
 return x;
};
const results=await Promise.allSettled([render(),scopeCheck()]);
for(const c of results)text(c.value??{error:c.reason?.message});

~~~

 const labels=[e.viewport==="desktop"?(e.dropdown?"下拉展开":"下拉关闭"):r.menuState==="关闭"?"主菜单关闭":`主菜单展开、集合${r.menuState}`];
 if(e.viewport==="desktop"&&e.skill)labels.push(fol);
 if(r.drawer)labels.push("320 px 抽屉",fol);
 if(e.path.startsWith("/spec-kit/"))labels.push(`${e.heading}选中`);
 const media=e.chapter?`纸纹平铺，${r.model.length} 张原 Three.js 静帧`:`${r.vectors} 个矢量层`;
 const display=visual.has(r.ordinal)?"通过 · 源图对照":"通过";
 return `| ${pad(r.ordinal)} | [${r.name}](${url(r.id)}) | ${labels.join("，")} | ${r.texts} / ${r.layout} | ${normalized[i].editedSpans} | ${media} | ${display} |`;
}).join("\n");
const section=`
## T020 全量转换

2026-11-27 将 T017 盘点的 15 个视图、14 条内容路径转换为 165 块具名原生画板，按视图和设备摆放在同一 Design 文件的「T020 全量转换」页。桌面 84 块（1440 × 900），手机 81 块（390 × 844），其中 30 块为默认态。 [全量转换页](${url("20:2")}) · [实施方案](../implementation/T020.md)

一次 Playwright 启动使用 T017 的 Make 快照，在每个实际视口中打开页面并操作菜单或目录。前两项取得逐项回执后，同一进程沿 Figma 服务器返回的续接编号提交其余项。165 次采集均返回 HTTP 200，各自取得独立的画板节点 ID。已核对 165 张浏览器参考图的哈希和尺寸、路径和章节、桌面下拉、手机菜单和抽屉及目录展开组合。Chromium 版本为 \`156.0.8078.4\`。执行清单 SHA-256 为 \`23c648a7fcea634a716f5f3e7da900da96e6d2ee044d9e983e24c2f97095c43e\`。

### 验收结果

| 检查 | 结果 | 证据 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 一次启动和唯一映射 | 165 / 165 | 全量页上 165 个 FRAME 的名称、节点 ID、位置、尺寸和裁切逐项通过读回，画板之间无重叠，用户逐页操作 0 次 |
| 正文、导航与可编辑性 | 165 / 165 | 检查了正文标题及内容锚点、桌面下拉开合、手机菜单、技能目录组合和 Spec Kit 当前栏目，所有画板均有原生 TEXT、FRAME 和 VECTOR 层 |
| 字体和图像 | 165 / 165 | 缺失字体计数为 0，首页恢复了源纹理平铺，验收了十张实时渲染静帧和各画板的 PNG 输出 |
| 参考图对照 | 42 / 42 | 覆盖 15 个视图的桌面和手机默认态，以及桌面下拉、手机主菜单和目录抽屉的代表性展开及折叠状态 |
| FR-012 与 FR-013 | 165 / 165（100%） | 全量验收通过，失败 0 项、缺前置 0 项、未执行 0 项。每项的画板链接与结果见下表 |

### 导入修正与差异

- 84 块桌面画板的顶栏内容按原型恢复到距视口左右各 112 像素。42 块桌面下拉态在实图核对时发现菜单被正文遮挡，已用原生 Auto Layout 的叠放顺序恢复顶栏覆盖关系，并将菜单透明度校正到 100%。按 1280 像素的居中容器复核实际边距，逐块重新读回及导出 42 块画板。抽样中下拉面板与原型约有 1 像素的水平偏移，正文、菜单和选中态通过核对。
- 165 块画板按原型视口裁切。十块首页均复用了源预览的 180 × 180 像素纸纹，恢复平铺及原层的混合方式。品牌和导航图标保留可编辑的矢量图层。
- 已按 T019 确认的方案使用 \`Noto Sans SC\` 替代中文无衬线，首页中文副标题恢复为 \`Noto Serif SC Medium\`。共调整 ${nText} 个原生文字层中的 ${nRanges} 个字体区间，其中 ${nStrong} 个源半粗体区间采用 \`Noto Sans SC Bold\`。保留英文原字体。抽样可见中文替代产生字形及部分正文行尾换行差异，正文内容完整。 [T019 字体确认](#t019-代表性试转)
- 十个首页状态均取得 Make 的实时 Three.js 图像，使用各次采集中的原始渲染静帧。文件夹和连接节点的姿态随采集时点变化，模型旋转、章节过场及菜单动效在 Make 原型中查看。 [Make 原型](https://www.figma.com/make/FOn29DUppcpuJ3bRP9QEOU/Agent-Foundry-%E6%96%87%E6%A1%A3%E7%AB%99)
- 首轮源图中有首页入场和目录展开过渡。并行刷新参考图时首页切换超时，随后串行在状态稳定后刷新 15 张本地参考图并通过对照。三张桌面下拉样例使用修正后的 Figma 渲染图复核。全量转换发起 1 次。

### 逐项结果

画板链接按 T017 清单顺序排列。原生文字和布局列为实际 TEXT 数与可调整的 FRAME、VECTOR 层数。字体区间列记录本次调整数。所有行均通过正文、可见导航状态、字体、图层和 PNG 核验，标注「源图对照」的行另进行了渲染图逐对比对。

| 序号 | Figma 画板 | 可见导航 | 文字 / 布局层 | 字体区间 | 图片或矢量 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
${rows}
`;
const anchor="| T020 全量转换                    | 未执行 | T019 已通过验收，可按 T020 的原任务范围启动。                                   |";
const markdown="specs/docs/001-docs-site-framework/analysis/figma-conversion.md";
const prepared=await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch\n*** Update File: "+markdown+"\n@@\n "+anchor+"\n"+section.trimEnd().split("\n").map(line=>"+"+line).join("\n")+"\n*** End Patch");
text(prepared);

~~~
